entry_mechanism: APA review of an overseas federal undertaking under NHPA Section 402
target_institution: U.S. Department of Defense; U.S. federal courts
claim_translation: base construction -> dugong cultural property -> agency procedural compliance
observed_outcome: Long litigation produced a Section 402 procedural standard but final summary judgment favored DoD.
explanatory_value: Shows how a local ecological/cultural claim entered U.S. administrative-law review through named organizations and counsel.
main_limit: One unusual U.S. statute and one site cannot represent all international legal advocacy.

entry_mechanism: Formal comments at method-statement and corrected-EIA stages
target_institution: Okinawa Defense Bureau; national ministers; Governor of Okinawa
claim_translation: base construction -> coral-reef biodiversity/dugong -> adequacy of survey prediction and mitigation
observed_outcome: Formal comments entered the record but the completed EIA did not itself stop the project.
explanatory_value: Shows a lower-threshold participatory channel where NGOs contribute science and critique without becoming litigants.
main_limit: Submission does not prove adoption or causal policy effect.

entry_mechanism: Residents bring injunction and/or damages claims against Japan under personality rights state-liability and special civil-law theories
claim_translation: aircraft operations -> chronic noise -> daily-life sleep health and mental harm
observed_outcome: Courts recognized compensable past harm for eligible residents while operational injunctions or wider claims were rejected/limited.
explanatory_value: Shows life-safety and everyday burden translated into repeatable resident-plaintiff litigation rather than ecological procedure.
main_limit: Damages judgments do not show that noise ceased; organization-to-individual membership is incompletely public.

entry_mechanism: Signature-backed local referendum request followed by inaction/mandatory-order litigation
target_institution: Mayor of Ishigaki; Ishigaki City Council; Naha District Court
claim_translation: GSDF deployment -> local autonomy/direct democracy -> claimed duty to hold a referendum
observed_outcome: Council rejected the event-specific ordinance and the 2020 court dismissed mandatory-order actions on procedural grounds.
explanatory_value: Shows a deployment controversy entering ordinance and administrative-litigation channels even without a referendum being held.
main_limit: Anonymized plaintiffs prevent automatic coding of A011 as an organizational party; no causal election inference.

entry_mechanism: Resident audit and local-government public-expenditure injunction under Local Autonomy Act
target_institution: Governor of Okinawa; Mayor of Okinawa City; Japanese courts
claim_translation: landfill ecology/economic feasibility/disaster risk -> legality and rationality of public spending
observed_outcome: First-wave and second-wave results diverged; later appellate/Supreme Court outcomes did not stop spending/project decisions.
explanatory_value: Shows environmental claims translated into fiscal legality and administrative discretion rather than only conservation speech.
main_limit: Must distinguish two litigation waves and must not label the movement group as plaintiff without pleadings.
